remarks: Welcome to Arroyo Townhomes, a boutique community of just 21 homes built in 2020 by KB Home in the heart of Anaheim. This move-in ready, three-story townhome offers 1,540 square feet with 2 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and a versatile downstairs bonus room that can easily serve as a third bedroom, guest suite, or home office. The second level is the heart of the home, with an open living area and a bright kitchen featuring a center island, white cabinetry, and electric cooking, flowing into the dining area for easy everyday living and entertaining.
